source.citation: Classified advertisement, 'Situation wanted—first class French cook in private family. 2001 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 4 October 1907 (vol. 66 no. 238).
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, storeys, material or outline
what_it_supplies: that 2001 Indiana Avenue was still a private residence in October 1907
